name: When Summer is Over
source:
It's almost time to leave. Someone like you could find it hard not to linger in this place – a place filled with so many memories, both bitter and sweet. You want to stay… you wish you could stay.

But there's something sinister lurking here, in this state you love so much. It's growing, even if you do nothing. If you let it continue, it will consume you, and you will die here.

You must say goodbye to your home, to Florida, for good… or it will bury you.

[From [url=https://cicadaqueen.itch.io/when-summer-is-over]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
差不多该离开了。像你这样的人很难不流连忘返——一个充满了太多回忆的地方，既有苦涩，也有甜蜜。你想留下来……你希望你能留下来。

但这里潜伏着一些险恶的东西，在你如此热爱的这种状态下。即使你什么都不做，它也在增长。如果你让它继续下去，它会吞噬你，你就会死在这里。

你必须永远告别你的家、佛罗里达……否则它会埋葬你。

[来自[url=https://cicadaqueen.itch.io/when-summer-is-over]Itch.io[/url]]
